neighbours.label: the word starting a date after 'on' (on the 5th of September, on May 13, on January 1)
fire: The army rested for three days and moved north again on the 5th of September.
The new commissioner begins her term on January 1 every fourth year.
They reached the river late at night and crossed it on the morning of the 19th.
The board of directors met on May 13 to approve the new plan.
The surgery was finally performed on the 14th of June that year.
The great earthquake struck on the twenty-first day of July.
Our club will hold its annual meeting on March 3 in the town hall.
The ship left the harbour on the 2nd of August with a full crew.
quiet: The army rested for three days and moved north again toward the hills.
The new commissioner begins her term after the election every fourth year.
They reached the river late at night and crossed it on a narrow raft.
The board of directors met in the office to approve the new plan.
The surgery was finally performed by the senior doctor that year.
The great earthquake struck the coast without any warning.
Our club will hold its annual meeting in the town hall this spring.
The ship left the harbour with a full crew and fresh supplies.
